terra.problem: Saying Jesus is not whispering adds a detail about His delivery that the text does not give.
The claim that forty appears often in Scripture reaches outside the passage without a reference.
“Zero hesitation” adds a detail about the brothers’ response that the text does not give.
Zebedee is named in Mark 10:35, not in the preceding verse, Mark 10:36.
“Total confidence” asserts the brothers’ feelings, and “gently” adds a tone to Jesus’ reply that the text does not give.
“Quick and sure, no pause at all” adds details about the brothers’ timing and confidence that the text does not give.
The text does not say the brothers answered fast.
“Full confidence” presents the brothers’ feeling as fact rather than a guess.
“In this moment” adds a time limitation to Jesus’ statement that the seats are not His to grant.
Saying the seats are not handed out by seniority adds a detail about how they are assigned that the text does not give.
The guess that the ten wanted the seats supplies a possible motive for their indignation that the text does not give.
“Nobody on that road was chuckling” asserts something the text does not say.
“First place is for the one who serves everybody” changes Jesus’ requirement for whoever wants to be first into a promise of first place for those who serve.
“The one who wants to be first becomes the slave of all” presents Jesus’ requirement as something that automatically happens.
Saying Jesus does not ask the disciples to do anything He has not already done makes a broad claim beyond what this passage says.
Saying James and John were angling for honor assigns a motive that the text does not state.
“I’ll say it with a quiet voice” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
